provenance: Deterministic Bun fixture; published 0.18.1 game source/content and real authored world/race/pursuit/behaviors. Candidate constructors imported explicitly from dedicated SDK worktree. No game dependency aliases, browser execution, or unpublished package adoption.
limitations: Candidate evidence is offline deterministic, not a native browser adoption of unreleased SDK.
Adapter excludes driving reaction/audio presentation; its published run was validated with exact position and velocity equality to actual Harbor driving over 30 simulated seconds.

Entity velocity derived from pose displacement includes legitimate traffic separation; internal motor velocity excludes recovery. Traffic remains authored path following and can physically push a car.
Additional overlap recovery is bounded to two passes; inconsistent overlapping solids can still require positional correction on later ticks.
